title: Blueprint update fails with 'should NOT have additional properties'
symptoms: A blueprint downloaded from the same scenario is rejected
cause: The blueprint object accepted on update holds flow, name and metadata only. A blueprint carrying scheduling or interface at its top level fails validation.
fix: Strip scheduling and interface from the blueprint before sending it, and pass scheduling as its own field if you need to change it.
apply: python: bp = {k: bp[k] for k in ('flow', 'name', 'metadata')}; body = {"blueprint": json.dumps(bp)}
affected: Make API v2, July and September 2026
